assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: repair-shop inventory catalog category illustration. Constraints: no logos, no model names, no lettering, no text, no people, no tools, no gradient backdrop, no colored background. This is a generic category illustration, not an exact device part. Match clean shopping catalog product photography.
